exerciseSets.description: One entry per set, in wktStepIndex/messageIndex order — both ACTIVE (exercise) and REST sets. Consumed by sync_activity_details (activity_exercise_set measurement), only for activities with activityType.typeKey == strength_training.

exercises.description: Garmin's ML-detected exercise candidates for this set, most-likely first — consumed as category/exercise_name from exercises[0]. Empty array on REST sets. Observed: all candidates identical (same category/name) at ~99.6% probability in every captured set, i.e. never actually ambiguous in this account's samples, but the array shape (not a single object) implies Garmin models it as ranked candidates.

category.description: Same vocabulary as create_workout's exercise catalog (internal/garmin/exercises/catalog.json), e.g. "PLANK", "LUNGE", "HIP_RAISE" — not verified 1:1 against the catalog's category set, but same naming convention.

probability.description: Percent (0-100), not consumed. Observed ~99.6 on every candidate captured.

repetitionCount.description: Consumed as reps. Null on REST sets; observed 0 on some ACTIVE sets (device detected the exercise but didn't count reps for it).

weight.description: Consumed as weight_kg — unit unconfirmed (always null in this account's captured samples, no weight ever logged on a device-tracked set; see #86's create_workout weight_kg for the separate, confirmed-kilogram upload-side field). Treat as kilograms provisionally (same assumption as weight_kg elsewhere in this codebase) until a non-null sample can verify the unit.

setType.description: Consumed as set_type. Observed: ACTIVE, REST.

startTime.description: GMT, not local — format matches the parent activity's startTimeGMT (verified: this activity's first set's startTime equals its startTimeGMT). Consumed as the point's time via _parse_gmt.

wktStepIndex.description: Not consumed — resets to 0 at the start of each detected exercise block, not a stable per-activity ordinal (see messageIndex). Null observed on the very last set of the captured activity (a long trailing REST after the workout ended).

messageIndex.description: Not consumed — a single running counter across the whole activity (0..N-1, gap-free), unlike wktStepIndex. Would be the natural per-set tag if this ever needs deduping/joining, but sync_activity_details doesn't currently tag on it.

title: Activity exercise sets (get_activity_exercise_sets)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_activity_exercise_sets(activity_id) — not present in get_activities_by_date's summary response at all, needs this separate call. Consumed by sync_activity_details for strength_training activities only (#42).

Verified against: one real strength_training activity, 2026-01-30 (activity_id 21711179290), 43 sets (21 exercise blocks x [ACTIVE, REST] pairs, plus a trailing REST). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
